subject: After the promotion meeting
text:
Saki,

Thanks for today's promotion meeting. Two things, please.

First, put the minutes of the meeting in the "Promotion meeting" shared folder by Thursday 26 November.
Second, book meeting room 2 for the afternoon of Wednesday 2 December for next week's meeting.

Hinata, please take the leftover handouts back to the storeroom. No hurry.

Ryo
